blocks.text: Group 2 dhaatein oxygen, paani aur halke tezaabon se react karti hain. Har soorat mein reaction ki shiddat group mein neeche barhti hai, jaisa ghat'ti ionization energies se tawaqqo hai.

blocks.prompt: Group mein neeche Group 2 dhaaton ke reactions ki shiddat ka kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Barhti hai, kyunke bairooni electrons aasani se nikalte hain.

items: Group 2 dhaatein oxygen, paani aur tezaabon se react karti; shiddat neeche barhti.
